resources.string: Your training, food and progress, together. Start with a simple personal log.
Enter targets you have already chosen, or leave them blank. Forma does not calculate or change them in this version.
Stored on this device in an encrypted database. No account, ads or cloud AI. Portable backup is not available yet; uninstalling removes your log.
Your log could not be opened. Close and reopen Forma. Your data has not been reset. If the problem continues, keep the app installed while investigating.
The change could not be saved. Your input is still here; please try again.
One place for your everyday effort.
Completed · compared with your weekly plan
Includes only entries you logged. Missing entries are unknown, and a logged day may be incomplete.
Early version · this review uses your logs and fixed rules. An AI chat coach is planned.
Simple editable logging templates. Choose exercises, reps and loads appropriate to your existing routine; these are not personalized prescriptions.
Your completed sessions will appear here.
For an unloaded or bodyweight set, enter 0 kg.
Enter the totals for the whole portion you ate, using a label, recipe or another source you trust. All four values are required; enter 0 only when that value is known to be zero.
%1$s kcal · P %2$s g · C %3$s g · F %4$s g
Adds the same portion and nutrient totals to today. Each tap creates one entry.
Enter at least one value. Saving replaces today’s measurement record, including any field left blank.
Average logged calories per logged day · %1$s kcal
Average body weight · %1$s kg from %2$s observations
Average weight difference from the previous 7 days · %1$s kg
A weight comparison needs at least 3 recorded days in each 7-day window. This is a data coverage check, not a medical assessment.
Your targets and plan have not been changed. These summaries describe your log; they do not explain the cause of weight changes.
Your recorded measurements will appear here.
When you next train, log your session so you have a starting point.
Your log shows fewer completed sessions than your weekly plan. Check whether you need to record a session or review the plan you chose.
Add more food records if you want a fuller review. Missing entries do not tell us what you ate.
Record measurements on more days if you want to compare weekly averages.
Review your sessions and recorded measurements together. More context is needed before drawing conclusions or changing targets.
